summary: Credit-powered VIP listings with promoted placement in the public marketplace, plus photo verification of users before they can post in chosen categories.

features.title: Configurable VIP packages
features.short: Set the duration and credit price of promoted listings
features.description: The administrator can create and remove VIP packages with a custom name, duration in days and Apps Hub credit price.

features.title: VIP listing placement
features.short: Place promoted listings ahead of normal results
features.description: An active VIP listing receives a visible VIP badge and sorts before regular listings in the main feed and within its category.

features.title: Apps Hub credit payments
features.short: Let listing owners purchase promotion with credits
features.description: Listing owners can select an active package while creating or editing an advert. The charge is processed safely through Apps Hub credits and retries cannot charge the same purchase twice.

features.title: Stackable promotion time
features.short: Extend an existing VIP period without losing remaining days
features.description: Buying another VIP package before the current period expires adds its duration to the remaining promotion time instead of restarting it.

features.title: User verification
features.short: Require a verification photo before users can post
features.description: The administrator can create any number of verifications with their own instructions, triggered right after registration, after a number of days or after a number of listings, and optionally limited to chosen categories. Users keep browsing and managing their listings and are only stopped from posting new ones where a verification applies, until an administrator approves the photo they sent. Photos are deleted as soon as they are reviewed.
